Indicator: Qualitative description of indicators of accuracy and possible rate of error of automated means
Value:
Our automated tools are required to meet a high accuracy threshold before deployment, validated through pre-launch testing of the tool's performance against defined control criteria. Following launch, automated tools are continuously audited to ensure they maintain a sufficiently high level of accuracy; tools that fall below acceptable accuracy levels are removed from use.
Automated tools are continuously improved through ongoing training using new information, including internal learnings (such as outcomes of expert manual review decisions) and external risk signals.

Indicator: Specification of the precise purposes to apply automated means
Value:
Advertising: We proactively detect and remove advertising content that violates our Ads Policies, which are designed to maintain a high customer experience bar for ads on the site. We require all advertising content to comply with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations; to be appropriate for a general audience, and honest about the products or services that ads promotes. We invest heavily in people and technology to protect customers, brands, and advertisers and the site from fraud and other forms of abuse. IMDb deploy a number of measures to ensure compliance with our Ad Policies and detect infringing ads, including through automated moderation tools that check millions of ads and their visible ad elements per day worldwide. To complement our automated measures, expert teams also conduct human reviews of ads to identify any potential non-compliance and apply the learnings as feedback to continually improve our tools.

Trustworthy Reviews: Our moderation processes for community content include machine learning models that detect content that violates our Contribution Guidelines and prevent it from being published. We strictly prohibit fake reviews that intentionally mislead by providing information that is not impartial, authentic, or intended for that title. We invest significant resources to proactively stop fake reviews. When we strongly suspect that a review is inauthentic, we suppress the review completely, so it is not displayed on the site.

Indicator: Safeguards applied to the use of automated means
Value: To safeguard against potential errors made by our automated tools, we implement processes to ensure that we have a high confidence rate that our automated tools operate as intended and to minimise mistakes. We do this by ensuring our automated tools meet a high bar of accuracy before they are launched by testing the provision of the control, and by continuously auditing our automated tools after they launch and removing from use automation that does not maintain a sufficiently high level of accuracy. We also constantly improve our automated tools by training them using new information, including internal learnings and developments (including outcomes of expert manual decisions) and external risk signals.
